sloka: निर्बिभेदोरसि ततो रावणं निशितैः शरैः ।राघवः परमायत्तो ललाटे पत्रिभिस्त्रिभिः ।। ६.१०४.३० ।।
transliteration: nirbibhedorasi tato rāvaṇaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।rāghavaḥ paramāyatto lalāṭe patribhistribhiḥ ।। 6.104.30 ।।

translations.english: Raghava pierced into the chest of Ravana sharp arrows and with great effort three sharp arrows on the forehead.
